title: PROFESSOR HALSELL'S ROOM 1886
text:

notes: Printed page 42. Full-page group photograph with caption running along the right side. Caption text is very difficult to read due to small size and image quality. The title 'PROFESSOR HALSELL'S ROOM 1886' is legible at the top of the caption.
